data.name: Federal Reserve Board — FEDS Notes (staff analysis)
data.permissionNotes: Official Board staff analysis, not independent reporting or an official recommendation. Free, keyless RSS metadata for discovery; only the exact reviewed August 26, 2026 repo-market item retains its bounded Board-original introduction. All other notes remain metadata-only; no full article scraping or AI permission. Board public-domain copy/distribute grant with non-Board exceptions supports local display/cache/backup with source credit. Media permission is ONLY Figure 1 of the August 26, 2026 repo-market note, bound to exact GUID/article URL/PNG URL/MIME/byte count/SHA-256. Figure 2, vendor data, unrelated items, regional Bank assets, seals/logos and website framing are not approved. Preserve the entire financial-market diagram without cropping and disclose authors' views, no endorsement. See docs/focus-stock-image-rights-followup.md; re-review any changed asset.
data.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

rightsPolicy.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; FEDS Notes staff analysis. Public domain under Board website policy, except identified non-Board materials. Authors' views, not Board concurrence or an official recommendation; no endorsement.

mediaAllowlist.caption: Financial-market diagram — Figure 1. Effect of Balance Sheet Decline on Repo Markets. FEDS Notes authors' views, not Board concurrence; not an official recommendation or endorsement. Preserve the whole diagram; no cropping.
mediaAllowlist.credit: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; Sriya Anbil, Alyssa Anderson, Lucy Cordes and Romina Ruprecht, FEDS Notes, August 26, 2026. Public domain under Board website policy.
